senses.gloss: f. (קָטֹן) small fruit, pulse, beans, peas &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 1:8">Bets. I, 8</cite> <he>הבורר ק׳ וכ׳</he> he that picks out (green) peas on the Holy Day.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:8">B. Mets. IX, 8</cite> <he>תבואה … ק׳ ק׳ וכ׳</he> if a person rents a field for the purpose of planting grain (<cite ref="V00036"><he>תבואה</he></cite>), he has no right to plant pulse, if for pulse, he may plant grain (Var: the reverse); a. e.—Pl. <he>קִיטְנִיּוֹת</he>, <cite ref="S00915"><he>קִטְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:15">Tosef. Ter. X, 15</cite>; a. fr.
